description: Find the closest colours in OTHER brands to a given paint colour or hex value, e.g. "Behr equivalent of Farrow & Ball Hague Blue" or "which Benjamin Moore is closest to #D1CBC1". Give either brand + name_or_code, or hex. Distance is CIEDE2000 ΔE with a verdict: under 1 practically identical, under 2 very close, under 3.5 close, otherwise similar (nothing above ΔE 6 is returned). By default returns the single best match per brand, closest first; pass brands to restrict the search (with one brand you get several options from it). Always pass on the caveat that on-wall results depend on base, sheen and tinting.

brand.description: Brand of the source colour (with name_or_code)

hex.description: Source colour as hex, e.g. "#3D4E57" (instead of brand + name_or_code)

name_or_code.description: Name or code of the source colour

name: find_equivalents
title: Find equivalent paint colours in other brands
